translation.question: 2025年のトロント国際映画祭（TIFF）のラインナップにおいて、独自の見出しの下に記載されていたプログラム部門はどれですか？
translation.expected_answer: スペシャル・プレゼンテーション
translation.translation_note: TIFF is rendered as トロント国際映画祭（TIFF） to ensure the question is independently answerable and unambiguous in Japanese, where TIFF can otherwise refer to the Tokyo International Film Festival.

backtranslation_en.question: Which program section was listed under its own heading in the lineup of the 2025 Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF)?

consistency.reason: The target language QA accurately translates the source question and expected answer, preserving the exact fact and intent. Expanding TIFF to Toronto International Film Festival is a standard and acceptable translation choice.
